title: Achievements
body:
![video: Achievements](media/1460466450320851024.mp4)

*Achievements shown are not final; there are still a bunch to add.*

Some of the weirder original vanilla achievements may not make it in, or their requirements may be a little different. For example, all achievements related to crafting a workstation block are now earned by placing the block. And 'On A Rail' is proving very hard to implement.
